findings.description: The rewrite only removes names found in `param.opts`. It no longer removes names found in `param.secondary_opts`, which the old code did through `difference_update(param.secondary_opts)`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a boolean flag such as `--verbose/--help` or `-h/-H`, where a help name appears only as a secondary option. Mechanism: that name stays in the help option names and is not treated as reserved. Impact: the auto-added help option collides with the user's secondary option, so it can shadow or override it, or produce a conflicting registration. Before this change the name was excluded.
